authorized_by: PI, explicitly, with the scaffold-hypothesis correction recorded in POLE_B_ENTITY_UTILIZATION_SCAFFOLD_HYPOTHESIS_AMENDMENT.json
THE_QUESTION_THIS_ANSWERS: Is the entity pathway load-bearing AT INFERENCE for the recovered Pole-A specialization?
THE_QUESTION_THIS_DOES_NOT_ANSWER: Did entity geometry CAUSE the specialization to emerge during training? That is the scaffold hypothesis (H2) and requires the no-entity +1,000,000-step continuation control. Nothing in this experiment may be used to argue for or against H2.
WHY_CLOSED_LOOP_AND_NOT_THE_EXISTING_ONE: POLE_B_ENTITY_UTILIZATION measured one-step KL / greedy-action agreement on states generated by the INTACT policy, and found ~97% agreement. That statistic systematically understates the episode-level consequence of an intervention: under closed-loop control a small number of changed decisions alters the subsequent state distribution and can compound. This experiment lets the ablated policy drive its own trajectory for the whole episode.

ESTIMANDS.notation: V(pi, arm, A) = win rate of policy pi under entity arm `arm` against Pole A. All four cells share the SAME seed block, so every quantity below is a SEED-LEVEL PAIRED contrast.
ESTIMANDS.delta_A_full: V(pi_A3, FULL, A) - V(pi_B3, FULL, A)
ESTIMANDS.delta_A_zero: V(pi_A3, ZERO, A) - V(pi_B3, ZERO, A)
ESTIMANDS.C_A: delta_A_full - delta_A_zero    <-- THE PRIMARY QUANTITY: how much of the Pole-A specialization gap is carried by the entity pathway at inference
ESTIMANDS.L_A: V(pi_A3, FULL, A) - V(pi_A3, ZERO, A)    <-- absolute capability cost of deleting geometry from pi_A3
ESTIMANDS.L_B: V(pi_B3, FULL, A) - V(pi_B3, ZERO, A)    <-- same for pi_B3
ESTIMANDS.why_L_A_and_L_B_are_recorded_separately: C_A can be ~0 while both L values are large and similar -- geometry helping general capability without explaining the specialization gap. Reporting only C_A would hide that case entirely.

DESIGN.pole: A only (OP6 + {min_alive_for_defender: 4}); Pole B is NOT evaluated here

seeds.disjoint_from: confirmatory training 17700001-17700002, confirmatory crossover eval 17800001-17800128, and the POLE_B_ENTITY_DIAGNOSIS block 17900001-17900128

DESIGN.action_selection: deterministic=True, matching the frozen crossover protocol exactly
DESIGN.checkpoints_are_frozen: no training of any kind occurs in this experiment; both checkpoints are read-only inputs
DESIGN.arm_definition_ZERO: the teammate AND enemy FEATURE tensors are set to exact zeros at every decision step, with validity masks left untouched. Because EntityResidualEncoder is bias-free throughout, 0 in -> 0 out at every layer and the masked mean pool of all-zero encodings is exactly zero, so g == 0 EXACTLY. This is an exact deletion of the residual, not a perturbation, and is asserted live on the trained weights by contract 1 below.
DESIGN.arm_definition_FULL: entity tensors exactly as gpu_env._core._entity_obs.build_entity_tensors produces them -- identical to how the sealed crossover eval fed them.

STATISTICS.procedure: paired percentile bootstrap over evaluation SEEDS, identical parameters to every prior sealed crossover in this project
STATISTICS.how_C_A_is_bootstrapped: per seed s compute d_full(s) = win(A3,FULL,s) - win(B3,FULL,s) and d_zero(s) = win(A3,ZERO,s) - win(B3,ZERO,s), then c(s) = d_full(s) - d_zero(s). Resample seeds with replacement and take the mean of c(s). C_A is NOT computed by differencing four independently bootstrapped win rates -- that would discard the seed pairing and inflate the interval.
STATISTICS.expected_precision_note: n=64 is smaller than the sealed crossover's n=128, so single-delta intervals will be wider (roughly +-0.15 vs +-0.11). C_A should nonetheless be comparatively well-determined BECAUSE of the pairing: the FULL and ZERO conditions share seeds, share environments, and differ only by a residual that alters ~3% of decisions, so d_full and d_zero are expected to be strongly positively correlated and much of the seed-level variance cancels in c(s). The realized correlation will be reported rather than assumed.

KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTRACTS_before_the_main_l: 1. ZERO arm drives the residual to EXACTLY zero on the TRAINED weights (torch.equal against zeros), for both checkpoints.
2. FULL arm residual is nonzero on the trained weights -- otherwise both arms are trivially identical and the experiment is vacuous.

3. INTERVENTION ISOLATION: at the reset state, grid / vec / agent_mask / mask are BIT-IDENTICAL between the FULL and ZERO arms; only the entity tensors differ. The ablation must not perturb the base observation.
4. The two checkpoints are genuinely different (sha256 mismatch) and both carry a non-None entity_encoder.
5. Live pole resolves min_alive_for_defender == 4 for Pole A, per the size-normalized gate used by every prior 4v4 evaluation.
6. Determinism: identical state + identical arm evaluated twice yields identical logits.
